notes: Audit mode reports finite coordinate, screen-bound, validity, AOI-overlap, and timestamp-segment fields without excluding trials.
Set validity_accepted explicitly for a device/export-specific validity filter; do not assume one universal validity code across vendors.
Use point_source=fixation for formal AOI analyses only when fixation point columns are available; otherwise auto falls back to gaze and records the fallback.
Coordinate scaling is applied only when source canvas width and height are explicitly present in the scene manifest; otherwise the coordinate contract is marked unverified.
The first 2 seconds are a scene-early reference, not a pre-stimulus baseline; pupil results are exploratory and luminance-confounded.
